description_text: Proposed procurement for NSN 5999014811914 SHIELDING GASKET,EL: Line 0001 Qty 230 UI EA Deliver To: By: 0041 DAYS ADO This Solicitation may result in an Automated IDC (Indefinite Delivery Contract). The term of the contract/order will be one year or until the aggregate total of orders placed against the contract/order reach 350000.00. The estimated number of orders per year is 8. The Guaranteed Minimum quantity will be 34. Items will be shipped to various CONUS and OCONUS (via consolidation and containerization point) DLA Depots. Approved sources are 18565 07-0501-7519; 18565 07-0501-7519-30; 18565 5M988-25M; 64098 1214-0780; 76301 5M988-25M. The solicitation is an RFQ and will be available at the link provided in this notice. Hard copies of this solicitation are not available. Specifications, plans, or drawings are not available. All responsible sources may submit a quote which, if timely received, shall be considered. Quotes must be submitted electronically.
